description: Department of Local Government - Western Province - Criteria to be adopted when Prescribing Service Charges for Seweraga services Maintained  by the Colombo Municipal Council Within its Authority Area.
categorisation: This gazette notification establishes regulatory criteria for prescribing sewerage service charges within the Colombo Municipal Council authority area. It creates a detailed regulatory framework with specific consumer categories, fee structures, and compliance requirements under the Municipal Councils Ordinance and Provincial Councils Act. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
